scope: Office sequence v2 (14 s): c03_04 + c03_05 as a narration-driven 'follow the money' montage; one visible action per beat; mute-test readable

shots.understanding: The company's cash (a tank of coins) is being let out, deliberately and fast.
shots.focal_point: the founder's hands on the outlet valve; coins bursting into the SPENDING pipe
shots.camera: static frame with a settling 3% pull

graphics.what: valve opens with anticipation; coins stream right

shots.rationale: Establishes the mechanism every later shot reuses: the tank is the company's cash.

shots.understanding: Money goes into advertising: a TV ad switches on and plays.
shots.lighting: TV glow on a blurred dusk office

graphics.what: coins pour into the TV via the ADVERTISING pipe; the BigCart rocket ad plays

shots.rationale: Match cut on the coin flow (left to right) from the previous shot.

shots.understanding: Money goes to employees: pay lands on every desk while people work and a new hire arrives.

graphics.what: payroll pipe drops coins that become PAY envelopes
WE'RE HIRING banner, new hire carrying a box

shots.rationale: Live workstations over a cached room plate.

shots.understanding: Money goes into infrastructure: servers installed and switched on.
shots.focal_point: the technician sliding a server into the rack

graphics.what: server slides in, LEDs cascade on, SERVERS pipe feeds coins

shots.rationale: Anticipation (pull back) then the shove, with follow-through.

shots.understanding: Three big outflows vs a trickle of revenue: the tank level falls.
shots.camera: pull out from the previous detail to the whole machine (1.22 -> 1.0), then push into the gauge to cut

graphics.what: ADVERTISING / PAYROLL / SERVERS outflows gush; REVENUE inflow trickles
kinetic type MONEY OUT (large) / money in (small)
graphics.why: type size encodes the imbalance; reinforces the mechanism for muted viewing

shots.rationale: Leaving the details is a pull-out to the model (motion-craft direction grammar).

shots.understanding: The cash cannot last: the gauge falls into the red and the alarm starts.

graphics.what: needle sweeps to EMPTY with mechanical wobble; warning lamp

shots.understanding: The company now depends on a decision made elsewhere: investors deliberating.
shots.focal_point: the investors at the table; one lifts the stamp

graphics.what: term sheet on the table; stamp raised

shots.focal_point: the term sheet as the stamp lands

graphics.what: stamp slams FUNDED on BigCart's term sheet on 'investors'

shots.rationale: Insert close-up so the key action is legible.

shots.understanding: The investor opens the capital line; money starts flowing to BigCart.
shots.focal_point: the valve and the coins starting

graphics.what: capital valve opens; coins flow right toward BigCart

shots.rationale: Same motif as the founder's valve: a deliberate match in action.

shots.understanding: Investor money refills the tank while spending continues: survival depends on it.
shots.focal_point: the investor pipe pouring into the tank

graphics.what: INVESTOR CAPITAL pipe drops in from above and pours; tank level rises

graphics.why: names the new inflow for muted viewing; pulses on 'capital'

shots.rationale: Return to the model: the same machine, now with its life-support line.
